summary: The 10-13/14 layer vehicle tb_s81_die_layer cannot be updated to the current die: the p4l DV die (bind9) contains NONE of its masters (dsfd_sp_ctrl_e, dsfd_sp_hc_c, dsfd_sp_su_h, dsfd_sp_collective_c, dsfd_sp_gather_c/capture_c, the hub VM). The DV die is 128 ROM frames (col_h9/h10/h9_MX_l4 + cfg7_seq_bfp), 16 vector slices (ot_s81sl_slice*: SU/HC/norm/capture/Engram distributed), 16 svc_rs attention services, gunit, bk_sel/bk_col, seq_host (ot_dsdv_fixed_issue calendar), 224 landings, 2,836 rlyh relays, 16 HBM ctrl_rg2, serdes/ucie. No compiler emits a DV layer program (seq_host calendar + CTL templates, frame cfg7 programs, svc / gunit jobs, return calendar) and no DV fixtures exist, so no layer can run on it yet. Delivered now: per-layer p4l price (the target), a full-RTL die elaboration + idle-run cost probe (build/run wall for the fleet-hours estimate), and the vehicle plan.
